items.title: colour test chart
items.description: 1/256th of the original image, recreated from 65536 individual flat filled overlapping tiles, so there is no gap issue even if the image is rotated. Should render fine in a browser. Used inkscape for the tracing and svgomg to clean up the mess after countless manual cleanup attempts -some of which worked, some didn't.
